sn41.1:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū Macchikāsaṇḍe viharanti Ambāṭakavane || || 2
sn41.1:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānam bhikkhūnam pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānam maṇḍalamāle sannisinnānam sannipatitānam ayam antarākathā udapādi || ||
sn41.1:1.3: Saññojananti vā āvuso saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhammā nānatthā nānavyañjanā udāhu ekatthā vyañjanam eva nānanti || || 3
sn41.1:1.4: Tatrekaccehi therehi bhikkhūhi evaṃ vyākataṃ hoti || ||
sn41.1:1.5: Saññojanan ti vā āvuso saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhammā nānatthāceva nānavyañjanā cāti ||
sn41.1:1.6: ekaccehi therehi bhikkhūhi evaṃ vyākataṃ hoti || ||
sn41.1:1.7: Saññojananti vā āvuso saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhammā ekatthā vyañjameva nānanti || || 4
sn41.1:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Citto gahapati Migapathakam anuppatto hoti kenacid eva karaṇīyena || || 5
sn41.1:2.2: Assosi kho Citto gahapati sambahulānaṃ kira therānam bhikkhūnam paccābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānam maṇḍaḷamāḷe sanninnānaṃ sannipatitānam ayam antarā kathā udapādi ||
sn41.1:2.3: Saññojananti vā āvuso saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhammā nānatthā nānavyañjanā udāhu ekatthā vyañjanam eva nānanti ||
sn41.1:2.5: Saññojananti vā āvuso saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhamma nānatthā ceva nānavyañjanā cāti ||
sn41.1:2.7: Saññojananti vā āvuso saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhammā ekatthā vyañjanam eva nānanti || || 6
sn41.1:3.1: Atha kho Citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 7 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Citto gahapati there bhikkhū etad avoca || ||
sn41.1:3.2: Sutam etam bhante sambahūlānam kira therānam bhikkhūnam pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānam maṇḍalamāle sannisinnānam sannipatitānam ayam antarākathā udapādi ||
sn41.1:3.3: Saññojanan ti vā āvuso saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhammā nānatthā nānavyañjanā udāhu ekatthā vyañjanam eva nānanti ||
sn41.1:3.4: ekaccehi therehi bhikkhūhi evaṃ vyākatam Saññojanan
sn41.1:3.5: ti vā avuso saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhamme nānatthā ceva nānavyañjanā cāti ||
sn41.1:3.6: ekaccehi therehi bhikkhūhi evaṃ vyākatam Saññojanan ti vā āvuso Saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhammā ekatthā vyañjanam eva nānanti || ||
sn41.1:4.1: Saññojanan ti vā bhante saññojaniyā dhammā ti vā ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānavyañjanā ca ||
sn41.1:4.2: tena hi bhante upamaṃ vo karissāmi ||
sn41.1:4.3: upamāya pidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa attham ājānanti || || 9
sn41.1:4.4: Seyyathāpi bhante Kāḷo ca balivaddo odāto ca balivaddo ekena damena vā yottena vā saññutto assu ||
sn41.1:4.6: Kāḷo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ odāto ca balivaddo kālassa balivaddassa saññojananti || sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyā ti || ||
sn41.1:4.8: Na kho gahapati kāḷo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ || na pi odāto balivaddo kāḷassa balivaddassa saññojanaṃ || ||
sn41.1:4.9: Yena kho te ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā taṃ tattha saññojananti || || 10
sn41.1:4.10: Evam eva kho bhante na cakkhu rūpānaṃ saññojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saññojanaṃ ||
sn41.1:4.11: yañca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanam || ||
sn41.1:4.16: yañ ca tattha tadubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo tam tattha saññojanaṃ || pe ||
sn41.1:4.17: Na mano dhammānaṃ saññojanaṃ na dhammā manassa saññojanaṃ ||
sn41.1:4.18: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanan ti || || 11
sn41.1:4.19: Lābhā ti gahapati || suladdhaṃ te gahapati
sn41.1:4.20: yassa te gambhīre buddhavacane paññācakkhu kamatīti || || 1
